response.rationale: R2 directly matches the definitive genetic finding (HTRA1 mutation) and is the core diagnosis. C1 adds imaging details but is an append-only completion of R2, so R2 is the strongest fixed candidate. R5 mislabels the syndrome as CADASIL despite the same genetic evidence; R3 and R1 focus on microbleeds without the genetic confirmation and are less specific.

rejected.why: Incorrectly labels the condition as CADASIL despite the HTRA1 mutation, which is not CADASIL.
HCHWA is not supported by the HTRA1 mutation; the imaging pattern is more consistent with HTRA1-related disease.
CAA is a possible differential but the genetic mutation and family history point to HTRA1-related disease, not sporadic CAA.
